verdict.rationale: GitLab's core docs confirm Git repository management (docs-7), authentication via SSH keys and personal access tokens (docs-5, docs-6), and programmatic access via API (docs-10), all foundational to creating/managing repos and browsing commit history. Community evidence corroborates migration and repo functionality (gitlab-comm-4) though also notes performance issues with pushes (gitlab-comm-1) as a caveat rather than a contradiction of the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of commit history browsing UI and independent hands-on verification of repo creation workflow.
